summary: CBDT Issues Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) Compliance Rules

items: CARF Alignment: Aligns Indian crypto exchange reporting with OECD global framework.
Reporting Scope: RCASPs must collect tax residency and TIN details for annual submission.
